verses.pali: “Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up desire for what is impermanent.

verses.pali: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo …pe…
verses.english: The eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are impermanent:

verses.pali: jivhā aniccā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo …pe…
mano anicco; tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
verses.english: you should give up desire for them.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should give up desire for what is impermanent.”
